title: Welcome, Money Explorer!
excerpt: A fun money adventure every day! Fill in your Money Explorer Card with a grown-up.
content:
Hello, Money Explorer! Every day we use money. We use it to buy milk, pencils, bus tickets and birthday cake.

From today, MoneyViel has a new money adventure for you every day. Some days it is a story. Some days it is a riddle, a game or a coin puzzle.

Each adventure is short. Read it with a grown-up, then try the little task at the end. Small steps make you a money star! ⭐

Your Money Explorer Card

Make your own card. Copy it into a notebook, or ask a grown-up to print this page. Tick one box after each adventure you finish.

🪪 My Money Explorer Card

⭐ My name: ____________________

🎯 One thing I want to save for: ____________________

🐷 Where I keep my coins: ____________________

💡 One way I can save ₹1 or ₹2 this week: ____________________

✅ Adventures I finished: ☐ ☐ ☐ ☐ ☐ ☐ ☐

Coming up this week

  • Monday: a story about Riya and her piggy bank 🐷
  • Tuesday: a money riddle 🤔
  • Wednesday: the needs or wants game 🧺
  • Thursday: a new money word 🔤
  • Friday: make a three-jar money station 🫙
  • Saturday: count the coins 🪙
  • Sunday: a story about sharing 🥭

Try it today

With a grown-up, find three coins at home. Put them in a line from the smallest value to the biggest. Which one is worth the most? Then put them back where they belong.

For grown-ups

Money for Kids is a short daily read for children aged about 6 to 13. Each post teaches one simple idea, like saving, needs and wants, or sharing, using small everyday amounts. Read it together, help your child fill in the card, and ask what they would like to save for.

This content is for general education only and is not financial, investment, tax or legal advice. Please consult a qualified professional before making financial decisions.
